newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME lean hog futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb lower to 0.100 higher, with pork belly futures called 0.200 cent higher to 0.200 cent lower, analysts said.

Steady to lower cash hog indications and another decline in pork cutout values were cited as pressuring influences. Packer cuout margins are deep in the red and this will keep their bids down, analysts said.
However, other analysts cited the continued lighter than expected pace of marketings and look for hot and humid weather to spread east through the Midwest and cut runs.
Packers will have to pay up for hogs early next week or cut back further on kills, they said.

Indications on pork bellies were mixed with much of the expected price changes seen on further spread action. July is expected to remain strong following the much lighter than anticipated deliveries and expectations that product prices are near to bottoming. The spread action will again pressure August, they said.
